query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM address_utxo WHERE date in <year window> AND owner_addr IN ('addr1q9dgm5dx75sg7haxd7xrgkdyqkzln36j739epx4h0aur4c6tqj46m7mmw95tehhrvqz59x83n7tsnyqcxarfraxvk4kqevsym9')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
